name: Exec Cluster E08: Tiered R-Multiple Take Profit
description: Tests: take_profit with r_levels and exit_pcts for partial exits
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Tiered R-Multiple Take Profit
# Tests: E08 (take_profit with r_levels/exit_pcts)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === VOLATILITY ===
atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === SIGNAL: RSI mean reversion ===
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)

# Buy oversold, sell overbought
entry_long = rsi_val < 30
exit_long = rsi_val > 70

held = hold_until()(enter=entry_long, exit=exit_long)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held, short_entry=exit_long)

# Fixed sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)

# E07: Stop loss as floor
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 2)

# E08: Tiered exits — 33% at 1.5R, 33% at 2R, 34% at 3R
take_profit(r_levels=[1.5, 2.0, 3.0], exit_pcts=[0.33, 0.33, 0.34])(
    risk_distance=atr_val
)
